title: IAM Concepts and Access Models: Match the Pairs
prompt: Match each concept on the left to its definition on the right.

pairs.right: Permissions are attached to a role that users inherit
The resource owner decides who gets access
Labels and a central policy enforce the access decision
Explicit rules apply to everyone, regardless of role
Access is only permitted within a defined time window
Approved temporary privilege with automatic revocation
Verifying the real person before creating the account
Trust between separate domains around an external identity
Signed assertion exchanged between identity provider and service
Delegation of authorization to a third-party app with limited scopes

explain: Distinguish between the **decision model** (RBAC, DAC, MAC, rule-based), **duration** (time-based, JIT), and **protocol** (SAML = authentication, OAuth = authorization).
